blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Metro Cebu’s air quality remained in the “Acutely Unhealthy” category on Sunday, September 20, with the Environmental Management Bureau in Central Visayas (EMB-7) recording its highest air quality index (AQI) reading at 1 a.m. The Metro Cebu monitoring station in Talisay City recorded an AQI of 296 at 1 a.m., before […]...
